kept_items.text:
Noam Shazeer, the AI legend Google paid $2.7B to bring back two years ago, has left Google, to join OpenAI.

Brutal news for Gemini.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete talent-move news: Shazeer leaving Google for OpenAI; strong engagement and traceable source.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text:
noam is one of the people I have most wanted to work with since the very beginning of openai.

only took 10 years.

i think it will be worth the wait!
kept_items.selection_reason: Altman official confirmation of Shazeer hire; primary-source executive statement, distinct angle from the news report.

kept_items.author: Polymarket
kept_items.text: JUST IN: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reveals companies testing Mythos warned it was a super weapon & said using it should require a “gun license.”
kept_items.selection_reason: High-engagement concrete claim from Amodei about Mythos testing feedback; strong distinct story.

kept_items.author: business
kept_items.text: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were among tech bosses at a G7 working lunch on AI, as the US decision to restrict access to Anthropic's most advanced models causes tension among allies
kept_items.selection_reason: Authoritative Bloomberg report on the G7 AI lunch and export-control tension among allies; concrete policy news.

kept_items.author: AndrewCurran_
kept_items.text:
Dario Amodei and Demis Hassabis called for a US-led coalition to determine the global standards and rules for AI in a closed-door meeting this morning at the G7.

Dario Amodei also said in his address that the coalition should structure access to frontier models and hardware - including both chips and other critical components - in a way that excludes China.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete reporting on Amodei/Hassabis call for a US-led AI coalition excluding China at the G7; distinct policy angle.

kept_items.author: ns123abc
kept_items.text:
BREAKING: SK Telecom Triggered Anthropic's Export Controls. Not Amazon

Days before Amazon flagged Fable 5, the White House called Anthropic about one company: SK Telecom

SK Telecom is Korea's largest carrier, investor in Anthropic, and partner of Project Glasswing

WH ordered to revoke SK Telecom's access to Mythos over alleged ties to China
kept_items.selection_reason: New detail reframing the trigger for Anthropic export controls as SK Telecom, not Amazon; concrete, distinct from prior coverage.

kept_items.author: ns123abc
kept_items.text:
BREAKING: JPMorgan just cut off its entire staff in Hong Kong from accessing Claude

Goldman Sachs also did the same last month

It’s over
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete enterprise-access news: JPMorgan Hong Kong cuts Claude access; distinct corporate fallout story.

kept_items.author: altryne
kept_items.text: MidJourney just announced... a full body ultrasound! "As powerful as MRI and as casual as a trip to the spa". They are calling it "the @midjourney scanner". The device uses 8,960 individual transducers arranged in a ring around your body, resolves motion at the picometer range, and processes 17 gigabytes of data per second. Midjourney claims fewer than 12 of these machines could perform more full-body scans than every MRI machine on Earth combined, deployed in a "Midjourney SPA".
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete surprising hardware product announcement from Midjourney with detailed specs; high engagement, distinct.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text:
Introducing LifeSciBench, a benchmark for measuring and improving how well AI supports real-world life science research.

Developed with 173 scientists from biotechnology and pharmaceutical research, LifeSciBench includes 750 expert-authored tasks across seven biological research areas.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official OpenAI benchmark release (LifeSciBench) with concrete scope; traceable primary source.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text:
GPT-5.4 helped drive a medicinal chemistry project from literature review to a validated experimental result.

Paired with Molecule.one’s Maria AI and specialized lab, the model proposed an unexpected way to improve a widely used reaction in drug discovery.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official OpenAI report of a GPT-5.4 medicinal chemistry result validated experimentally; concrete distinct science story.

kept_items.author: chamath
kept_items.text:
It may be overfit so it’s a bit early to declare any sort of victory but it is really good to see open-weight models catch up to the closed source labs so quickly after their latest releases.

With recursive RL, the delta in time between a closed source model and an equivalent open-weight one keeps shrinking.
kept_items.selection_reason: Practitioner/investor analysis on open-weight models closing the gap with closed labs via recursive RL; distinct viewpoint.

kept_items.author: johnschulman2
kept_items.text: PPO had a second wave in the LLM era for reasons unanticipated by the original paper - the importance-ratio objective fixes biases from numeric error, async training, and forward pass noise; the clipping objective affects entropy through a mechanism that we didn't know about at the time.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong technical observation from John Schulman on why PPO works in the LLM era; high-signal practitioner analysis.

kept_items.author: sairahul1
kept_items.text: Andrej Karpathy: "90% of Claude's mistakes come from missing context, not a weak model." 41% mistake rate without a CLAUDE.md, 11% with a 4-rule baseline, 3% with a 12-rule version. Lists the 12 rules senior engineers settled on for agentic coding.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner data on context engineering reducing agent mistake rates; useful technical analysis.

kept_items.author: julien_c
kept_items.text:
Llama.cpp has a new branding + official website.

Run local models today! Now more than ever, open source must win.

By @alekgrygier and @ggerganov at ggml/hf
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source tooling update: llama.cpp official website/branding launch; traceable practitioner source.

kept_items.author: WSJ
kept_items.text: Exclusive: Apple plans to raise prices. CEO Tim Cook called the move "unavoidable" because the AI boom is driving up chip costs.
kept_items.selection_reason: Authoritative WSJ report linking Apple price rises to AI-driven chip cost inflation; concrete industry-impact news.
